subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: without

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given prepositions. 

 
 
• The preposition '**Without**' means 'not having something' or 'lacking something.
 
• 'With' means in the company or presence of somebody/something.
 
• '**Beyond**' as a preposition means 'further away in the distance (than something)
 
• '**After**' means 'later than' and 'next in time or place'. After can be used before a noun phrase (as a preposition)
 
 
 
• As per the given meaning of the above prepositions **'without'** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 1.

Complete Paragraph: *The Covid-19 pandemic has deeply affected people across the world. During these difficult (1) times __frontline workers have been at the highest risk as __(2) they __have been stepping out to work daily **__(3) without __**proper protective gear. An NGO reached out to people to (4)______ funds to procure PPE kits, masks and sanitizers for (5)______ among the frontline workers. Several school children participated (6)______ this noble initiative. They collected old newspapers and books and (7)______ them to raise a good sum of money which was (8)______ used to buy kits. The children were happy to (9)______ and learnt how taking care of each other is very (10)______ in such challenging situations.*
